waybackify rewrite [flags] <source.md>

Apply a manifest to a markdown source

Apply a manifest to a markdown source: rewrite each live link per
the manifest, precedence exclude → rewrites → entries → untouched +
warn. Fenced code and link text are never touched; already-archived
links pass through.

Output: the published form written to -o. A url the manifest holds
no verdict for warns on stderr and exits 1 — surfaced, never
guessed at.

Arguments:
  <source.md>            markdown source file (pristine, live-link form)

Flags:
  --manifest|-m <file>   manifest to apply (wayback.json) — required
  --output|-o <file>     destination for the rewritten markdown — required
  --help|-h              Show help

part of the wayback.charlie.dev mirror tooling
